In today's episode of The Daily Brief, we cover 2 major stories shaping the Indian economy and global markets:
1. Lounge Wars – DreamFolks vs Airport Giants
DreamFolks, India’s biggest airport lounge aggregator, is facing a major challenge as dominant airport operators like Adani and GMR start bypassing it with their own tech platforms. Amid allegations of pressure tactics and banks pulling out of deals, DreamFolks' monopoly is under threat, raising questions about the future of the lounge access ecosystem.
